title: Thingstudio custom node descriptor (.node.json)
description: The descriptor half of a custom node package. Authoritative prose and the cross-field rules the schema can't express: interfaces/node-descriptor/SPEC.md. User walkthrough: docs/user-guide/custom-nodes.md. The editor currently ignores unknown top-level keys for forward compatibility; this schema flags them.

type.description: Namespace/name id, e.g. custom/dht22. The thingstudio/ namespace is reserved for built-ins.

kind.description: Decides where the node sits in a flow and which entry function .node.py must define.

label.description: Name shown on the canvas and in the palette.

title.description: Canvas title when it differs from label (defaults to label).

hidden.description: Hide from the palette (still usable in a flow file).

presetType.description: When set, the panel shows a save/load-preset control for this type.

screenOutline.description: Show the ScreenOutline widget in the panel.

description.description: Short self-documenting blurb shown in the property panel.

color.description: CSS color for the node outline. Default grey.

bgcolor.description: CSS color for the node fill. Default grey.

icon.description: One or two characters shown in the icon chip.

group.description: Palette section. Default 'general'; a new name gets its own section after the built-in ones.

priority.description: Order within group, lower first. Omit to sort after every built-in in that group.

eventSource.description: A source that waits on an external event: .node.py must also define 'async def wait(properties)'. No intervalMs needed. Only valid with kind 'source'.

requires.description: Hardware the node needs; checked centrally against the target at compile time.

capabilities.description: Capability names the node needs, e.g. ["pio"] or ["espnow"].

type.description: Wire type, checked when wires are drawn.

name.description: Dict key your Python reads the value by.

kind.description: Field type. 'default' must match it (a number for number/pin, a string for text/textarea/select/configRef/target).

default.description: Used when a node instance doesn't set the property. Type must match kind.

options.description: Required for kind 'select'; 'default' must be one of the values.

configType.description: Required for kind 'configRef': the config type the picker offers, e.g. 'thingstudio/config/i2c-bus'.

singleton.description: On a configRef: resolve the flow's single config of 'configType' at compile time instead of the stored id (the singleton WiFi/I2C-bus route). Only valid with kind 'configRef'.

pinUse.description: On a pin: whether it is read or driven; checked against the board and claimed as a resource. Default 'input'. Only valid with kind 'pin'.

pinPull.description: On an input pin: the internal pull the node configures. Default 'none'. Only valid with kind 'pin'.

help.description: Short note shown under the field.

placeholder.description: Hint text in an empty text/number input.

step.description: Number step: a number, or "any" for arbitrary fractional values.

optional.description: A pin field where -1/blank means 'not wired'.

visibleWhen.description: Show this field only when the named property satisfies the condition (a data-driven conditional).
